clips.title: The story
paras: Krusk has gone through the documents you procured and concludes that Gol'dir is kept in a big Syndicate base up north, quite possibly in the Alterac Mountains. Gol'dir has languished in captivity far too long and needs to be freed.

Krusk, in Tarren Mill, has gone through the documents you brought back after Infiltration. They point to Gol'dir being kept in a big Syndicate base up north, quite possibly in the Alterac Mountains. Krusk says the captivity has dragged on far too long and Gol'dir needs to be freed.

Gol'dir is held in the top room of the inn at Strahnbrad, and the inn is packed with Syndicate. A Rusted Iron Key opens the lock, and Jailor Borhuin carries it; Borhuin may be in any building of the town.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: From what I can tell of the documents you procured, Gol'dir is being held in a large Syndicate base to the north, most likely in the Alterac Mountains. He has been held captive far too long and must be freed.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Give me the key, adventurer, I will undo the lock myself.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you, friend. I led the expedition from Durotar under the Warchief's orders, but as you can see, our plans went somewhat awry. They have held me captive here in this town, forcing me to work, hauling burdens, digging...
What I have suffered is unimportant, however. There is important information you must deliver to whomever is leading our group now.
